summary: Box code split out of box.py (estimates, materials, third-party RFID), CFS notifications and humidity warnings, release status/apply in the installer helper.

tested_with.cfs_application: custom CFS firmware v3.13 (API7 raw RFID reads, runtime config)
tested_with.notes: Third-party RFID tags (Bambu, MIFARE vendors) are decoded from raw tag reads of the CFS: a CFS that does not report them (stock 153) reads Creality tags only. box_cfs_runtime needs v3.13 or later.
